Tests bytes input extraction API (extract)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"bytes\":\"pdf/fake_memo.pdf\",\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"bytes\"}")
    result = await extract(input)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
